title: The two sides of the dual geometry on identical word pairs: pre-registration
status: DRAFT until scripts/freeze_prereg.py --prereg prereg/dual_paired_prereg.json has written dual_paired_prereg.lock.json and both files are committed. Edit only before freezing.
relation_to_thesis: Added after the vocabulary-side result (dictionary_specificity_prereg.json, results commit 3e3f32c) was known. That test and the activation-side test (word_specificity_prereg.json) used different pairs: single-token pairs on the vocabulary side, all pairs on the activation side, so their side-by-side comparison in the paper is descriptive. This test makes it a paired comparison on identical pairs. Changes nothing frozen in any earlier pre-registration. Frozen before any output of this test was produced.
claim_tested: On the same single-token word pairs, with the same pool of null words and the same null draws, word-pair contrasts built from unembedding rows sit further toward the head relative to random word groups than contrasts built from activations do, and the activation contrasts are no more tail-ward or head-ward than random word groups.
gemma_policy: Every test reported with and without gemma-2-2b; a conclusion is called robust only if it holds both ways.
pairs: Exactly the pairs of the committed vocabulary-side run: single-token pairs under the published token rule, concepts with at least 4 such pairs. The script refuses to run if the per-concept pair counts differ from the committed dictionary_specificity results.

word_vectors.vocabulary: unembedding rows, read as in dictionary_specificity.py
word_vectors.activation: context-free word activations from the word_specificity runs (published extraction, mean pooling, max_length 16), read from their caches; re-extracted with the same routine only if a cache is missing

null: lexical null of word_specificity_prereg.json: 2n words from the pooled vocabulary of the clean words, excluding the concept's own, split into two groups of n; 1,000 draws, seed 0. Both sides use the same word list, so the same seed gives the same draws on both sides.

statistics.gap: Gini(concept) - mean Gini(null), per concept and side; positive = further toward the head
statistics.d: gap_vocabulary - gap_activation, per concept; averaged over concepts within a model
statistics.across_models: one-sample t-test against 0, two-sided, alpha 0.05; Wilcoxon reported alongside; TOST with bounds +/-0.082 Gini units

primary.B: mean activation-side gap across models, on the same pairs

decision_rule.asymmetry_confirmed: A: 95% CI above 0 in both the all-model and without-gemma versions; AND B: TOST equivalent within +/-0.082 in both versions
decision_rule.no_asymmetry: A: TOST equivalent within +/-0.082 in both versions
decision_rule.validity: at least 6 of 8 models must be run; otherwise not testable

secondary_reported_not_primary: mid layer (activation side at hidden state floor(L/2), as in word_specificity)
vocabulary-side gap on these pairs, as a check against the committed dictionary_specificity result
multiplicity: A and B are both required for the single verdict; no other test enters the conclusion.
reporting: The result is reported whatever it is.
